items.title: St. Gallen, Stiftsbibliothek, Cod. Sang. 845 : Commentary on Boethius, De consolatione philosophiae (I-IV)
items.desc: A copy of a commentary on the first four books of the work De consolatione philosophiae by Boethius († 524), written by many hands in the Abbey of St. Gall near the end of the 10th century or the beginning of the 11th century. The manuscript contains a multitide of Latin and Old High German glosses, of which the Old High German glosses are written in the so-called bfk-Geheimschrift (secret script).
